tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
p = Path('main.go')
data = '''// This file provides the executable entry point for rendering a greeting template.
package main

import (
	\"log\"
	\"math/rand\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World"'! Random integer: {{.}}'"\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Intn(100)); err "'!= nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
'"'''
fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=p.parent, prefix='.main.go.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(name, p)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(name):
        os.unlink(name)
PY
sed -n '1,120p' main.go
git status --short -- main.go go.mod go.sum"
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w main.go && git status --short -- main.go go.mod go.sum'
